Paper Name: HOMER optimization of standalone PV/Wind/Battery powered hydrogen refueling stations located at twenty selected French cities
NOTES: Study covers 20 French cities with 3 scenarios: S1 (PV-Wind-Battery), S2 (Wind-Battery), S3 (PV-Battery). Scenario 3 is the 'winner scenario' with lowest costs. Values below use Scenario 3 (PV-Battery) as primary/baseline configuration since authors identify it as optimal. Where only scenario-specific data exists, ranges across all 3 scenarios are given. Daily electrical load of 443.05 kWh/day used to infer annual: 443.05 x 365 = 161,713 kWh/yr. Daily H2 load = 125 kg/day. Annual H2 production ~4,179 kg/yr (avg S3). TOTAL ANNUAL LOAD DEMAND inferred from daily electrical load x365. LCOE and COE values reported as LCOE by authors; LCOE placed in both LCOE and COE fields (COE/LCOE equivalence noted). LPSP not reported — system is fully renewable with battery backup, 100% renewable fraction. eta_PV = 19.1% (cell efficiency from Table 1); derating factor 88% also reported. eta_EL = 85% (HHV basis). eta_INVT = 95% (converter efficiency). H2_LHV = 120 MJ/kg from nomenclature. Cap_H2 cost = $1,148/kW (Table 1 reports hydrogen tank capital cost in $/kW). No diesel generator — all scenarios are 100% renewable (Cap_DG, diesel constants, c_DG, om_DG, rc_DG, life_DG, e_DG, N_DG all null). No fuel cell component — electrolyzer produces H2, no FC power generation (Cap_FC, c_FC_cap, c_FC, om_FC, rc_FC, life_FC, e_FC, N_FC all null). Wind turbine capital/replacement/O&M are per kW ($1,000/$1,000/$12). Battery: Generic 1kWh Lead Acid, capital $110/kWh, replacement $100/kWh, O&M $10/yr, lifetime 10 yrs, roundtrip eff 80%. N_WT, N_H2, N_EL given as ranges for Marseille (C17, best S3 case). Compressor: capital $2,500/kW, O&M $50/yr, lifetime 10 yrs. Dispenser: capital $54,000/kW, O&M $170/yr, lifetime 10 yrs. Discount rate i=3.92%, inflation 2%, project lifetime 25 yrs. PV tilt angle 35° for all sites. Avg NPC: S1=$1,561,429; S2=$2,522,727; S3=$1,038,117. Min NPC=$886,464 (Marseille, S3). LCOH (winner S3): $13.5–16.5/kg.
